passage:
Dear Mr. Davis,

Easy access to airport transit is supposed to be a top priority for your company, but my experience at Terminal 3 last Tuesday shows that your promises are not being met with proper service. I am writing to report a very stressful and unsafe breakdown in your special assistance service, which caused a two-hour delay and made me miss my connecting international flight.

My problems started the moment I got off Flight AC442 at 2:15 PM. Even though I booked a wheelchair transfer three days in advance and reminded the cabin crew before landing, no one was waiting at the gate to help me. A ground staff member told me that a system backup meant all wheelchairs were busy. While I know that busy travel times can be hard to manage, leaving me to wait in a crowded walkway for forty minutes without a chair was very painful and exhausting for someone with my walking difficulties.

In addition, communication from your customer care team was terrible. When a worker named Sarah finally arrived at 3:10 PM, she told me I had to wait in another area because the elevator for accessible transfers was broken. I sat in that waiting spot for nearly an hour without water or a restroom, watching hundreds of other passengers walk easily through the terminal. By the time I finally reached my departure gate for Zurich, the boarding door had been closed for fifteen minutes.

The extra $1,400 cost to rebook my flight and the physical tiredness caused by this bad experience are terrible, but being treated so poorly is what upset me most. A major international airport should not treat travelers with disabilities as an afterthought. This was not a small mistake; it was a total failure to provide the basic equipment and staff needed to move a passenger safely through your building.

I am requesting a full explanation of why there was a shortage of staff that led to this long delay. I also expect a full refund for my $220 hotel room and the ticket change fees caused by the missed connection. I have attached my booking confirmation and my expense receipts for your review.

I look forward to hearing from you soon with a clear explanation of how you plan to fix these issues so other passengers do not go through this.

Sincerely,
Eleanor Vance
